text:
tina_finance: FYI AP flagged invoice BR-INV-2026-2108 from BlueRidge Systems — no PO matched and the invoice total ($27,460) doesn't line up with the CSV usage they attached. Two line items: platform seats $4,200, inference usage $23,260. Anyone own approvals for BlueRidge?

caleb_procure: pulling PO registry... we have PO-33100 for an evaluation engagement, excludes on-demand usage. Not seeing an active PO for monthly consumption. :mag_right:

acct_bot: SYSTEM: Invoice BR-INV-2026-2108 uploaded by tina_finance. Status -> routing_hold (missing PO).

rachel_ops: If this is runtime infra it should go to cost center 347-Platform. @oliver_prod usually approves BlueRidge run costs.

oliver_prod: I can approve but need the detailed breakdown by region + per-hour rates. Also the CSV totals should match the invoice before I approve. Can someone paste the vendor CSV?

tina_finance: Pasting vendor CSV excerpt (cols vendor provided):

```
date,region,hours,rate_per_hour,amount
2026-02-03,us-west,600,10.00,6000.00
2026-02-04,us-east,1500,11.00,16500.00
2026-02-10,eu-central,200,18.30,3660.00
```

caleb_procure: The CSV sums to $26160 for usage rows but invoice shows $23,260 usage. There's a $3k delta — maybe they applied a credit/discount or mis-typed a rate. Vendor note in email mentions "monthly rebate" but not clear.

acct_bot: SYSTEM: AP note created: "usage total mismatch between invoice and attached CSV".

rachel_ops: @tina_finance can you check the invoice PDF for any credit memos or discount lines? Sometimes vendors add a manual credit line but OCR misses it.

tina_finance: Checked PDF — no explicit credit line in header. The vendor included a separate one-line "partner rebate" PDF but it's a separate attachment, not on the invoice. AP didn't pick it up.

oliver_prod: Procurement usually wants the vendor to reissue with the PO on the header and the rebate applied on the single invoice for audit. For this cycle we can do a retro PO + hold payment until approval, but we need vendor confirmation of the $3k rebate.

caleb_procure: I'll create an internal retro PO: PO-R-2026-399 routed to @oliver_prod. Note to vendor: please reissue invoice with PO-R-2026-399 on header and consolidate rebate.

acct_bot: SYSTEM: PO PO-R-2026-399 created by caleb_procure. Invoice BR-INV-2026-2108 linked to PO-R-2026-399. Payment hold: set until approval and vendor confirmation.

oliver_prod: Reviewing PO-R-2026-399 now. I'll approve once vendor confirms rebate amount or reissues a corrected invoice.

caleb_procure: Reached out to BlueRidge account manager asking for reissued invoice with PO on header and for rebate confirmation. ETA from vendor: EOD.

acct_bot: SYSTEM: Action item created for AP: "verify reissued invoice matches CSV and PO".

tina_finance: Received vendor reply: they confirm a $3,000 partner rebate applies but said they "booked it as a credit memo separately due to billing system constraints" and will attach the credit memo as a combined PDF and reissue.

oliver_prod: OK once vendor reissues with the PO on header and a single invoice total of $24,160 (seats $4,200 + usage $19,960 after rebate) I will approve. Confirm GL code 5002 and cost center 347?

tina_finance: Confirm GL 5002, cost center 347. Finance will post an interim accrual for the outstanding amount.

acct_bot: SYSTEM: Waiting for vendor reissued invoice. Payment hold remains.

caleb_procure: Vendor just reissued: BR-INV-2026-2108-R with PO-R-2026-399 on header and combined credit memo. New total $24,160. Linked in Coupa.

acct_bot: SYSTEM: Reissued invoice BR-INV-2026-2108-R uploaded. Linked to PO-R-2026-399. Payment hold still until approver sign-off.

oliver_prod: Approved PO-R-2026-399 and the reissued invoice. Posting approval now.

acct_bot: SYSTEM: Approval recorded. Payment hold released. Invoice scheduled for payment Net 7 from approval. Journal entry created for interim accrual reversal.

tina_finance: Thanks all. Noting procurement follow-up: ask vendors to include PO on invoice header and consolidate credits — helps OCR. Closing once payment posts. :white_check_mark:
